name: Goading Ammunition

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. Reference-only powers are described in text and have no action button.

summary: Reference-only: A creature damaged by this ammunition saves DC 13 Charisma or loses Reactions until its next turn starts.
text: Reference-only: A creature damaged by this ammunition saves DC 13 Charisma or loses Reactions until its next turn starts. The ammunition becomes mundane after hitting.
